message: Vector Rebel 3.2.67: recognize actual native SCBA InspectionCOMPLETE Item Log links by exact inspection instance, so a submitted SCBA can advance safely to the next airpack.
releaseNotes: Vector Rebel 3.2.67 fixes the verified real-browser stop after submitting AP-04: on the Standard SCBA item page Vector displayed the newly completed inspection as SCBA InspectionCOMPLETE with no separating space, which the previous Item Log row parser could not recognize. The new receipt reader inspects the visible native completed inspection hyperlink directly, checks its exact SCBA Inspection 113271 template and same submitted instance ID, and additionally verifies the exact Standard SCBA item page. Only then does it record a successful submission and navigate to the next airpack. It never retries native Submit on an uncertain receipt. Already-running 3.2.66 inspection queues survive the update in the same tab, including previously submitted form instance IDs. All existing physical-check authorization and failure-note protections remain required.
